credits_text: On Halloween night, Daniel Hayes put on a mask. 30 years later... he never took it off.
other_text: MOODYFUL PICTURES and YELLOWFLOWER PICTURES present a film by ARIANA STARK. CASTING: PARIS KHANDROS, JOEL RAYBURN, REED FRANKLIN, HEATHER SIESS, DANIELLE ROY, SEAN STARK, DECKER FRANKLIN, KHOLE KASTNER, ALLIE KASTNER, TODD HOUGH. DIRECTED BY ARIANA STARK.
